name: nanobot
description: Your personal AI agent, with a browser workbench, memory, tools and automations.
changes: First catalog release: nanobot 0.4.0 with workspace access, persistent state and host-restricted model keys.
notes: The URL is private to your workspace. Workspace members can administer this agent.
Keep a browser tab open while a task or automation needs to run. Work stops when the sandbox parks.
Model usage is billed separately by your provider.

inputs.help: Optional. Defaults: openai/gpt-5-mini on OpenRouter, gpt-5-mini on OpenAI, claude-sonnet-4-5 on Anthropic.
